job_title: AI-Enabled Software Test Engineer - New Grad

Google ADK or equivalent AI development kits
Agentic AI framework design and implementation

key_responsibilities: Design and execute comprehensive test plans for Navigator Intelligent Apps using Agentic AI and Generative AI tools
Automate test case creation, execution, and validation across API and UI layers using AI-enabled frameworks
Develop and maintain API automation workflows and UI automation suites

Investigate software defects, assess customer impact, and escalate critical issues in collaboration with development teams

Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the release cycle to ensure alignment with functional specifications and quality standards

company_research.summary: Ciena is a mid-to-large enterprise (approx. 9,000 employees) in the optical networking and software industry, currently pivoting toward AI-driven infrastructure and high-speed connectivity. While the company reports strong financial growth for FY2025/2026, it recently executed a significant 22% workforce reduction in January 2026 to realign with changing market conditions. Employee sentiment is generally positive regarding work-life balance and remote flexibility, though some reviews suggest limited internal promotion pathways for junior roles.
